title: Android input ANR during checkout-to-leaderboard navigation
reproduction: Add Credits, no wallet | Tap Connect twice rapidly | Press Android Back | Tap Leaderboard
fact: An Android ANR dialog appeared, and ActivityManager recorded a 5,112 ms MotionEvent timeout. Repeated Wait did not provide lasting recovery. Video 06 shows the ANR dialog at 00:50.
hypothesis: Main/UI thread scheduling or rendering pressure; recording codec and emulator CPU contention are confounders. No root cause proved.
fix: Profile main-thread blocking and rendering during modal dismissal, wallet errors and destination changes. Keep navigation responsive and recover without requiring process restart.
verify: Repeat the exact missing-wallet → rapid Connect → Back → Leaderboard sequence 20 times on physical Android and the emulator, both recorded and unrecorded. Capture main-thread traces; require no ANR and timely input response.

title: Outfit cards leave an empty third column on the primary test size
reproduction: Open Hideout at 1080×2400/420 dpi | Scroll Solana and Outfits
fact: Both grids display two narrow columns with a large empty right strip at 1080×2400/420 dpi. Small profile fits three columns.
hypothesis: Width formula uses window width while the actual scroll content is narrower, possibly with fractional rounding.
fix: Compute card width from measured container width and gaps so the intended column count fits. This reduces unnecessary scrolling and balances the shop.
verify: At both tested densities and an intermediate width, show all columns without overflow, large unused strips or clipped fixed actions.

title: Pass and skin checkout hide the actionable missing-wallet reason
reproduction: Fresh offer → Get Game Pass | Tap Connect wallet | Hideout → Beeman → Unlock
fact: No compatible wallet is installed. Pass/skin show a generic wallet request failure, while Add Credits names the missing-wallet condition.
hypothesis: Different error presentation paths or retained wallet error state.
fix: Use the specific missing-wallet message consistently and provide a clear install/open-wallet route plus Retry. The player should know what to do without sharing diagnostics.
verify: On a clean device without wallet, open each purchase entry and confirm the same actionable message; install a test wallet and retry successfully.

title: History asks for wallet connection without a connect action
reproduction: Leaderboard → History | Read “Connect your wallet to see your runs” | Look for a connect action in this view
fact: Disconnected History says “Connect your wallet to see your runs” but has no local Connect button.
hypothesis: Empty state is informational text only.
fix: Add Connect wallet in the empty state and return users to History after cancellation or connection.
verify: From a disconnected launch, reach History and connect/cancel without leaving for the store; after connection fetch the actual account history.

title: First phone preview is blank before the model appears
reproduction: First open of Frost phone preview | Observe stage after about 2 seconds | Wait and choose Back
fact: Initial Frost capture after about two seconds shows an empty stage with rotation instructions. A later back view renders. Exact ready time is not known.
hypothesis: Filament/model initialization is asynchronous without visible progress.
fix: Show a loading state until the model is ready, then reveal rotation controls; provide retry/error feedback on failure.
verify: Cold-open all phone previews on physical hardware and a throttled emulator; require immediate loading feedback and a visible model or actionable error.

title: Software-renderer black-frame artifact
reproduction: Run tutorial using swiftshader_indirect | Capture black frame | Restart QA emulator with host GPU
fact: Tutorial produced a black lower frame with swiftshader_indirect; the later host-GPU run did not show it.
hypothesis: Software-renderer compatibility or capture path rather than confirmed app-wide rendering defect.
fix: Document the supported emulator graphics configuration and investigate only if it reproduces on supported physical GPUs.
verify: Repeat tutorial on a physical Android device and host-GPU emulator with identical APK; inspect both display and recording.
